claude_proposed_widenings.name: non-spell ongoing activated ability for magic items
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines an honest passive weapon bonus with a second ability that creates a temporary weapon-bound state, waits for a later hit by that same weapon, then resolves a save-gated rider and expires on first hit or after a timed window. Existing magic-item mechanics admit passive, immediate activation, triggered reaction, or composites of those, but not an activated ongoing rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
